== Summary ==
Slip “•Ord Mantell (DARK)” cut unchanged from page 1 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-24.pdf Virtual Set 24 release sheet] (PDF file created 2 February 2025), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (590, 1087, 1102, 1809)). Version [[Ord Mantell (V)]] (Original). Not a recreation.
